The biggest trade on an LNG construction site is not welding. It is driving.

Alaska LNG: 3,519 truck drivers of 11,850 direct hires — more than pipefitters, welders and insulators combined. Trucks move the bulk materials, the modules, the equipment and the people, with 250 to 270 of them running at peak.

One American project, published trade by trade. No Gulf or African LNG project publishes its own. So read it as the shape of a big construction job, not as a headcount for Ruwais.

What you actually need: a valid licence issued in the host country, first. Defensive Driving appears in QatarEnergy's contractor HSE regulations as a required course, and the contractor arranges it.

What nobody could show us: heavy-vehicle licence categories or conversion rules for Saudi Arabia, the UAE or Qatar, from any government source. If someone quotes them to you confidently, ask where they read them.

Ten roles, every source, at the link in bio.

We never ask for money for jobs.

Alaska LNG: 2,311 labourers and helpers of 11,850 direct hires. One American project, published trade by trade. No Gulf or African LNG project publishes its own.

posts.instagram:
There is no pipefitter certificate. Not in any country, from any issuing body.

We went looking, because it is sold constantly. There is no personnel certification standard for pipefitting anywhere we could find. The tickets on a piping crew belong to the welder, not the fitter. If a training centre offers you a "certified pipefitter" qualification, they are selling a document no employer recognises, because there is nothing to recognise.

What exists instead is the code the work is built to. On an LNG or refinery site that is usually ASME B31.3, covering materials, design, fabrication, erection, examination and testing of process piping. Knowing that code, and reading an isometric, is what keeps you on the job.

The number: Alaska LNG counts pipefitters, welders and insulators together at 1,566 of 11,850. The source does not split them, so neither do we.

We never ask for money for jobs.

#oilandgas #EPC #energyjobs #piping #construction

posts.instagram:
6G is a position, not a certificate.

It means the pipe is fixed at 45 degrees and you work all the way around it — the hardest of the four test positions. You do not get "a 6G". You get a welder qualification, taken in the 6G position, under a code. Anyone selling "a 6G certificate" on its own either does not know the subject or is counting on you not knowing it.

The three codes, and what each actually does:

ASME BPVC Section IX — qualification of welding procedures, and performance qualification of welders and operators.

ISO 9606-1 — qualifies the person, not the procedure. Your ability to manipulate the electrode or torch by hand. Manual and partly mechanised fusion welding of steels; automated welding excluded.

AWS D1.1 — the structural steel code. Procedure and welder qualification, fabrication, inspection, acceptance.

Which one you need follows the work: process piping goes to ASME, structural steel to AWS.

The number: 1,566 of 11,850 on Alaska LNG, counted with pipefitters and insulators.

We never ask for money for jobs.

#oilandgas #welding #EPC #energyjobs #LNG

posts.instagram:
There is no Gulf rigger licence. There is no Gulf crane licence either. Neither exists.

This is the role where that phrase sells the most worthless paper, so here is how it works. The client sets the requirement, project by project. QatarEnergy requires lifting personnel — rigging supervisors, riggers, crane and forklift operators — to be certified against its own technical regulations, not an international scheme. A different client wants something else.

What does exist is third-party bodies operating inside the Gulf. TÜV Rheinland's Qatar scheme LPC-005 certifies rigger, banksman, rigging supervisor and lifting supervisor: minimum age 18, 15 to 20 hours, written and practical at 70 percent, valid between one and three years. The scheme itself says client requirements still have to be met on top.

Misquoted constantly: LEEA's own qualifications are for lifting equipment engineers and inspectors, not crane drivers.

The number: about 1,300 operators of 11,850 on Alaska LNG.

We never ask for money for jobs.

#oilandgas #rigging #EPC #energyjobs #construction

posts.instagram:
This trade mobilises last. Which is exactly why people apply too early, hear nothing, and give up.

The evidence: on Alaska LNG the first construction peak, around 4,200 workers, is heavy civil and welding-intensive pipeline trades. The second, around 4,500 in 2029, is mechanical and electrical-intensive facility construction. E&I follows civil and piping. Apply at the same time as the welders and you are two years early.

An LNG plant is an explosive atmosphere, and that drives the qualifications. CompEx Ex01 to Ex04 covers installation, inspection and maintenance of equipment where gas and vapours are present — UKAS accredited, valid five years. The IECEx Certificate of Personnel Competence runs twelve units, from basic awareness to design and audit.

Now the honest part: both are widely respected, but we could not find a single Gulf client document naming either as contractually mandatory. Real and useful, not provably compulsory. Better you hear that from us than assume it.

The number: 397 of 11,850 on Alaska LNG.

We never ask for money for jobs.

#oilandgas #electrical #EPC #energyjobs #LNG

posts.instagram:
Train at the wrong centre and the card cannot be issued. Not later, not after an upgrade, not ever.

CISRS states it plainly: it will only issue a card for training and assessment carried out at a CISRS accredited centre. Scaffolding training anywhere else does not convert and does not count. It is the most expensive avoidable mistake in this trade — check the centre against the CISRS list before you pay, not after.

The route built for workers outside the UK is CISRS OSTS. Accredited centres operate in Abu Dhabi, China, India, Ivory Coast, Kazakhstan, Nepal, Nigeria, Oman, Qatar and Trinidad. Levels 1 to 4, plus inspection and supervisor.

Know what the card is and is not. QatarEnergy requires scaffold to be erected only by a qualified scaffolding contractor to its own requirements — it does not name CISRS. The card gets you hired by the contractor; it is not itself the client's rule.

No source publishes a scaffolder headcount, so we are not inventing one.

We never ask for money for jobs.

posts.instagram:
One NDT certificate travels with you between employers. The other one does not.

ISO 9712 is third-party certification: an independent body examines you, the certificate is yours, valid five years, and it moves with you when you change company.

ASNT's SNT-TC-1A is different in kind. ASNT itself states that certificates based on it are employer-based programmes for which ASNT does not hold responsibility, and that you are certified by your employer under your employer's written practice. Change employer and you generally start again. Not a lesser document — a different thing. But if you are paying expecting it to be portable, ask which scheme it is under first.

What the levels mean: Level 1 tests under written instructions and supervision, and cannot select the method or assess results. Level 2 chooses techniques, calibrates, interprets and evaluates. Level 3 takes responsibility for the facility, the procedures and the staff.

Welding inspection: CSWIP 3.1 needs three years of verified experience, 70 percent on every part, valid five years. AWS CWI is 72 percent on three parts, valid nine years.

We never ask for money for jobs.

#oilandgas #NDT #welding #EPC #energyjobs

posts.instagram:
OSHA says its own card is not a certification and is not required. Those are OSHA's words, on OSHA's website.

"The Outreach Training Program is voluntary and OSHA does not require Outreach training." And: "an OSHA card is not considered a certification or license." People are sold OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 every day as a requirement for Gulf work. They are not. They are a US awareness programme, and the body that runs it says so.

What a Gulf client actually demands: QatarEnergy's corporate HSE standard requires HSE advisers to hold at least one of a NEBOSH Certificate or Diploma, Chartered Membership of IOSH, a Diploma in Occupational Safety and Health Management or IIRSM membership, or Registered Safety Professional status — plus its own competence assessment.

Note the IOSH line. It is chartered membership, CMIOSH, not the three-day Managing Safely course that is often sold as though it were the qualification. Very different bars.

No source publishes an HSE headcount. We are not inventing one.

We never ask for money for jobs.

#oilandgas #HSE #safety #EPC #energyjobs

No ticket exists for this job. We looked properly, and there is nothing to require.

No issuing body and no employer document we could find sets a certification requirement for a site materials controller. General supply-chain qualifications exist — CIPS, APICS CPIM — but we found no evidence that any EPC contractor asks for them for this role.

The absence is the useful information. If someone is selling you a warehouse or materials certificate as the thing standing between you and a job in the Gulf, there is no standard behind it.

What counts instead is experience with a materials management system and with preservation requirements, and that is learned on a site rather than bought.

The job: receiving, preserving, storing and issuing everything the site installs, and knowing where all of it is. The Alaska Department of Labor treats material handling and logistics as two of its ten occupational groups for pipeline construction.

That is the last of the ten. All of them, with every source, at the link in bio.

We never ask for money for jobs.
